name: Revealed
description: Revealed is an always-on account intelligence layer for commercial teams selling into healthcare and life sciences. Connect it to Claude and pull your buying-group map, the latest change signals on your target accounts and the people in them, and ranked next-best-action recommendations — without leaving your workspace. Sales, Marketing, and RevOps teams use it to run daily triage, prep for meetings, prioritize accounts, and ground outreach in a real, recent signal. The connector is read-only: it surfaces account and signal data from Revealed into Claude and never writes back to Revealed or touches your CRM, email, or calendar. Access is scoped to your own Revealed workspace and account book. Requires a Revealed account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Revealed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Revealed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.revealed.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Revealed MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Revealed lists 14 MCP tools, including get_account, get_account_brief, get_company_signal, get_company_signals_by_tag, get_person, list_accounts, list_people, list_personas, list_tracked_signals, mcp_status, plan_usage, and recent_changes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Revealed?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Revealed in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Revealed requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Revealed is developed by Assure AI, Inc (dba Revealed). It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
